total_model.summary: Model projects 43.4 total points (CLE 25, LV 19). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 2.0), Wind x pass rate (lowers total 1.7), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.0). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
